Xelvin is looking for an experienced Production Test Engineer with a strong Electrical Engineering background to join the engineering team of a leading technology company in Eindhoven. Performing Design for Testability (DfT) reviews during product development. Designing and maintaining automated production test setups. Supporting New Product Introduction (NPI) activities. Performing root cause analysis on production and test failures. Improving test coverage, production yield, reliability and manufacturing efficiency. Collaborating with multidisciplinary engineering teams throughout the complete product lifecycle. Arbeidsvoorwaarden A competitive gross salary in the range of € 3.500 – €5.500 per month excluding 8% holiday allowance, depending on experience, technical expertise and results. Relocation package from Xelvin (see onboarding & benefits).27 paid holidays in addition to public holidays, pension scheme and travel allowance. Holiday allowance of 8% of annual salary. A job with perspective. After the Xelvin contract you will be offered a direct contract with your employer. Career-oriented education, training and development opportunities. Excellent primary and secondary employment conditions. Onboarding & Benefits Your first house in the Netherlands will be arranged by Xelvin, with the help of our relocation team. Furthermore: A relocation assistance allowance will be paid to cover the cost of relocating to the Netherlands. You (and your family) will be picked up at the airport or train station and taken to your new home. Onboarding support: assistance with setting up a Dutch bank account, health insurance, BSN registration, dentist and GP registration and other practical matters. We organize several social gatherings throughout the year with all Xelvin employees and recruited engineers. Functie-eisen To succeed in this role, you bring: Mandatory Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering (Electronics / Electrical Engineering only). Strong knowledge of analog and digital electronics. Experience designing electronic circuits and printed circuit boards. Must have: Proven experience with Altium Designer. Experience developing test solutions for electronic products. Experience working with laboratory and measurement equipment such as oscilloscopes, power supplies, DAQs and signal generators. Experience within electronics manufacturing, semiconductor, embedded systems or power electronics environments. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Fluent communication skills in English. Some experience with Python and/or C++ (basic). Preferred Experience with automated test systems and production environments. Experience with Design for Testability (DfT).
